input.quote: 8.1 By Commerce One. Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred by Corio or its Customers arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party; provided that Corio or its Customer promptly notifies Commerce One in writing of any such claim and promptly tenders the control and the defense and settlement of any such claim to Commerce One at Commerce One's expense and with Commerce One's choice of counsel.
input.rationale: Section 8.1 gives Corio (and its Customers) a Commerce One defence-and-indemnity for third-party claims that the Software infringes patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret rights, with the usual notice, tender-of-control and cooperation mechanics, and the standard remedy ladder: procure the right to continue use, replace or modify to make the Software non-infringing, failing which termination and a pro-rated refund of fees paid (p0086-p0087). Section 8.2 keeps exclusions narrow (use outside the Documentation and third-party modification), i.e. no combination or specification carve-outs — that omission favours us and is not a deviation since those exclusions are only permitted, not required. On the super-cap element, Section 9 expressly excepts "LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8" from the 12-month fee cap, so the indemnity is uncapped — better for us than the 3x annual fees super-cap the fallback allows. The clause therefore sits at the fallback position and is acceptable as drafted; it does not reach preferred because the indemnity is IP-only (no heads for Commerce One's breach of applicable law, Commerce One-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and defence control sits wholly with Commerce One. There is no Corio-side indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, so the "narrow Customer indemnity" concern does not arise. These are preferred-only gaps noted for information, not redlined.
